verdict.rationale: Sketch's AI page and MCP docs show that an external MCP-compatible AI client such as ChatGPT or Claude can drive Sketch directly. Through that connection it can recreate components and entire pages from a repo, swap light and dark mode components, generate color palettes, tidy layers and replace placeholder text. However, prompt-driven generation depends on a third-party AI client rather than a built-in generator, and no evidence shows prompt-to-first-draft or full mockup creation from scratch. Missing for 10: built-in natural-language design generation, explicit documentation of prompt-to-layout or mockup drafting, and independent or hands-on corroboration of output quality.
